summary: GH Research PLC, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, solely to announce its attendance at the American Psychiatric Association Annual Meeting in San Francisco from May 16-20, 2026. The filing contains no financial terms, no event-related details such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes, and no binding corporate action. It is a routine disclosure of a corporate attendance at an industry conference, with no material implications for shareholders. Under US-equivalent reporting, this is a simple notice of participation in a conference, not a special situation.
